lock.title: Heating lock
lock.description: For rooms that should not heat. If the heating is turned on or the valve opens, it goes off again at once and you get a message. Only frost lifts the lock, until the room is warmer again.

data_description.lock_frost_on: From this value on the lock is set aside.
data_description.lock_frost_off: Heats up to here, then the lock applies again.
data_description.lock_wait_sec: If the valve does not close the command is repeated, then the alarm goes off.

ai.title: Set up with AI
ai.description:
How it works:
1. Choose an AI service and name your wishes if you like.
2. The AI suggests fitting devices and temperatures.
3. You check the suggestions and can change everything.
4. Only **Save and close** in the menu applies them.

The AI provider receives names, areas and kinds of your thermostats, sensors, persons and fans plus the current settings of this thermostat. Measured values and states are not sent.

data_description.wish: For example: the kitchen should be a little warmer than the living room.

ai_review.title: Check the suggestions
ai_review.description:
**Reason given by the AI:** {reason}

These are only suggestions. Change or empty what does not fit.
